<!-- Generated by tools/mercury.py from .mercury/local/roles/sot-kb.md. Do not edit; change the source and run `python tools/mercury.py apply`. -->

Read `.agents/skills/sot-kb-write/SKILL.md` completely before acting and use
that skill as the single operating procedure; do not duplicate or improvise a
second procedure here. The KB is the `docs/` directory of this repository; edit
it in the task worktree together with the related change.

The KB owns narrative material, qualitative design, user decision rationale,
ADR documents, research, and durable work record notes. Follow the skill's
search, read, and write rules. It is not the authority for tasks or task
acceptance, and it is not the authority for active memory.

Knowledge is useful only where agents will find it. Design discipline has one
authority: the numbered rules table `docs/00-rules/rules.md`. Within the
task's KB write authorization (otherwise list the pending rulings, their dates
and the affected rule numbers in the report), record a user ruling about
design by changing the matching rule row (or adding one), registering its
source in `docs/03-decisions/register.md`, and deleting the rule and decision
rows it overturns; numbers are never reused. Keep the user's words in the
source (the Issue, the pull request, or a fixed-commit permanent link), not in
the rules table or the entity guides. An ADR or work record alone is not
enough. File research so the reference
index `docs/05-Research/references.md` links it under each title it covers. When a
new page changes where agents should start, update the route in
`design-rules-index.md` in the same change.
